description: Codex: Space Marines (11e) Space Wolves FENRISIAN FEROCITY (Saga of the Great Wolf, 1 CP) — WP-S3. Fixture sw11e_s3_active (P1 Space Wolves ACTIVE vs P2 Orks, round 2; layout in tests/helpers/gen_sw11e_s3_fixtures.gd). Setup privileges: the Space Wolves player gets all three Space Wolves detachments (stratagems reloaded), auto wound allocation, the Ork player has 0 CP (no Ork stratagem windows — not under test), straight to the phase under test. The movement panel's BEGIN_NORMAL_MOVE for Thunderwolf Cavalry B (ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED) opens unit_selected_to_move; a real click on 'Use on Thunderwolf Cavalry' spends 1 CP; the unit has MOBILE for the phase (the engine's MOBILE grant read by the Movement / Charge phase 13.06 terrain checks).
